groups.title: One more thing · an eval is a gate, not a number

beats.label: Run it as a gate
beats.cue: [needs-key] “--gate exits non-zero on regression vs the pinned baseline.” That's the CI job.

verify.note: diffs against the pin run-cli-eval just set (same spec name + dataset = same baseline key): regressions=0 → “gate: PASS” → the new run is promoted; a regression exits non-zero instead

beats.label: List the recorded runs
beats.cue: Every `crewhaus eval` run lands in .crewhaus/evals/index.jsonl — a score history, not a one-off number. The compiled bundle isn't in the table: it writes its own run dir and nothing else.

verify.note: on camera: the two CLI runs above, the gate run flagged as base. Only `crewhaus eval` appends the index — offline verification runs this before any scored run, so it prints “no recorded runs match”

beats.label: Show the pinned baseline
beats.cue: And the pin every later run is measured against — keyed by spec and dataset.
